oversize_policy: Exclude overlength examples before quota selection. Retain a question case when smaller faithful source instances meet its quotas. Exclude a case for length only after establishing that its required behavior has no fitting instance; missing implementations and insufficient source populations are separate coverage gaps.
replay_selection: Deterministic capped equal allocation across training question types, stratified within each type, without replacement. Select S1 from its component training pools and S0 separately, excluding embedded S0 replay from S1.
replay_contract: Explicit visible historical-contract adapter; preserve original trace semantics and never relabel historical graph hashes as S2 graph-content versions.
split_policy: Preserve published source-group splits and held-out wording. Never move a subject or unordered target pair to another split to fill a quota. Retain original S0/S1 held-out panels for retention evaluation.
